findings.title: Cleanup listener disabled when only V2 feature enabled
findings.body: registerListener now requires Profile.Feature.ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ to fire, while evaluator() uses ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2. If only V2 is enabled, RoleRemoved/ClientRemoved/GroupRemoved events are ignored, so management().*.setPermissionsEnabled(...,false) is never called and orphaned authorization objects/permissions are left behind.

findings.title: Wrong owner used for resource lookup breaks per-client checks
findings.body: hasPermission(ClientModel,String) uses resourceStore.findByName(server, client.getId(), server.getId()) and hasPermission(String) uses findByName(server, CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE, server.getId()). AdminPermissionsSchema creates/finds resources with findByName(server,name) and create(server,name,server.getClientId()). Using server.getId() as owner will not match, so per-client resources are never found and every check falls back to the all-clients resource, causing false denies for single-client grants and false allows for all-clients grants.

findings.title: Possible NPE when all-clients resource does not exist
findings.body: In hasPermission(ClientModel,String) when the client-specific resource is null, code does resource = SCHEMA.getResourceTypeResource(...) which can return null (unsupported schema, null type, or missing resource) and then immediately calls authz.getStoreFactory().getPolicyStore().findByResource(server, resource) without a null check. That throws NPE and turns an authorization check into a 500 error.

findings.title: getClientsWithPermission returns aggregate type resource name
findings.body: getClientsWithPermission iterates resourceStore.findByType(server, CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE, ...) and adds resource.getName() for every granted resource. The aggregate Clients resource itself has that type, so a grant on all-clients adds the literal name Clients to the returned set. Callers expecting client IDs will filter/list incorrectly.

findings.title: getResourceName has no Clients branch
findings.body: getResourceName special-cases USERS_RESOURCE_TYPE to return All users or the username, but has no branch for CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE added in this PR. Client resources fall through to resource.getDisplayName(), which is not populated for FGAP resources, so UI/API displays null instead of the clientId for client permissions.
